claim: 耆那教的自我表述：全知 Jinas 的教法是宇宙永恒本质的表达；此世传承溯至大雄（传统纪年 599–527/510 BCE）。
locator: SEP 开篇两句：'The Jains are those who consider that the teaching of the omniscient Jinas is the expression of the eternal essential nature of the universe.'；'The only extant teaching is that of Mahāvīra (traditional dates 599–527/510 BCE, in Magadha, South of modern Bihar), the last Jina of the current cosmic period.'
note: 两处均逐字核对。'最后一位 Jina' 即站内'第24位'之意，但序数不在来源内。
uncertainty: 年代为传统纪年（见 evidenceLimits 第1条）。

claim: 传统自称教法永恒、无创立者；大雄为公元前6世纪人、佛陀同时代人，其教义是对婆罗门教的反应与拒斥。
locator: IEP 导言：'According to its own traditions, the teachings of Jainism are eternal, and hence have no founder.'；'the Jainism of this age can be traced back to Mahavira, a teacher of the sixth century BCE, a contemporary of the Buddha.'；'Like those of the Buddha, Mahavira's doctrines were formulated as a reaction to and rejection of the Brahmanism'
note: 三处均逐字核对（第三处以截断形式核至 'the Brahmanism'）。'当代人'的依据仅此一条来源。
uncertainty: 佛陀年代不在本包来源内，无法互校（evidenceLimits 第2条）。

claim: 非正统定位：耆那教与佛教、顺世论因否认吠陀权威而并称非正统 darsanas。
locator: IEP 导言：'Jainism and Buddhism, along with a school of materialists called Carvaka, were regarded as the unorthodox darsanas'（截取核至 'unorthodox darsanas'）；续句 'because they taught that the Vedas and Upanisads... had no authority' 以同段抓取文本核对
note: 与站内《印度哲学》overview 的正/非正统分类一致。

claim: 耆那教哲学=文献载体中思想家们的哲学探究总和；本条目区分哲学与教团实践。
locator: SEP：'Jaina Philosophy is the set of philosophical investigations developed by thinkers as they appear in these different corpuses (Malvania & Soni 2007; Potter & Balcerowicz 2013, 2014).'；'This path came to involve structured monastic and lay communities.'
note: 两处逐字核对；学理/教团之分是本条目的规范要点（任务 scopeAndCautions）。

claim: 形上学为二元论与原子论：六实体（jīva、pudgala、dharma、adharma、ākāśa、kāla）；谛义经作七谛六实体。
locator: IEP §1：'the basic constituents of reality are souls ( jiva ), matter ( pudgala ), motion ( dharma ), rest ( adharma ), space ( akasa ), and time ( kala )'；SEP 引 TS：'TS 5.38. (exists only in some textual traditions). Time is also a substance. So, there are seven categories and six types of substance.'
note: 两处逐字核对；'atomist and dualist' 另见 SEP：'Jaina metaphysics is an atomist and dualist conception of the world'。
uncertainty: TS 5.38 的文本传统差异照录（'exists only in some textual traditions'）。

claim: 七谛：我、非我、业入、系缚、遮制、灭、解脱（TS 1.4）；业入等四谛描述灵魂与业物质的分合。
locator: SEP 引 TS：'TS 1.4. The categories are self, non-self, inflow [of karmic matter], bondage [with karmic matter], stoppage [of the inflow], destruction [of the bondage], liberation.'
note: 逐字核对。

claim: 业为物质：其积聚把灵魂拉回身体；一切业（善恶）皆系轮回。
locator: IEP §1：'karma, which is understood to be a kind of matter, and that accumulation draws them back into a body after death'；IEP §3：'all karma, both good and bad, leads to rebirth in the body. No karma can help a person achieve liberation from rebirth.'
note: 两处逐字核对。

claim: 生命层级与素食：每一个生命都有灵魂、可被伤害或帮助；按感官数分级；根本规则是 ahiṃsā；素食与绝食至死的理想。
locator: IEP：'Every living thing has a soul, so every living thing can be harmed or helped.'；'The cardinal rule of interaction with other jivas is the rule of ahimsa.'；'Consequently, Jains are required to be vegetarians.'；'the ideal way to end one's life, for a Jain, is to sit motionless and starve to death.'
note: 四处逐字核对。绝食至死为传统理想之死的陈述，非本百科之推荐。

claim: 常见'无神论'标签的准确含义：所否认者是创世神；诸神同受业与轮回支配。
locator: IEP §1：'it is frequently said to be atheistic. What is denied is a creator god above all.'
note: 逐字核对；正文措辞与此限定一致。

claim: 认识论：kevala 为顶点；pramāṇa 清单含感知、可信言说、超感官、他心通与 kevala，推理后补；除 kevala 外一切知识皆暂定。
locator: IEP §2：'The Jain list of pramanas includes sense perception, valid testimony (including scriptures), extra-sensory perception, telepathy, and kevala , the state of omniscience of a perfected soul. Notably absent from the list is inference'；'Since reality is multi-faceted, none of the pramanas gives absolute or perfect knowledge'；'any item of knowledge gained is only tentative and provisional.'
note: 三处逐字核对。

claim: 多面论（anekāntavāda）：实在多面、无单一视角能完全把握；矛头双向反对胜论与佛教的实在观。
locator: IEP：'reality is multifaceted ( anekanta , or 'non-one-sided'), such that no one view can capture it in its entirety'；'no single statement or set of statements captures the complete truth about the objects they describe'；SEP §3.4：'This is the famous doctrine of the many-sidedness of things ( anekāntavāda ).'；'It also goes against the Buddhist conception, according to which only what is a non-complex unity is real (Gorisse 2022b).'
note: 四处逐字核对；反对胜论处：'It notably goes against the Vaiśeṣika conception, according to which qualities, like "being ochre", exist independently of substances like "pots", and are linked with them thanks to a relation of inherence.'

claim: 七支谓词的源头与七式：Āmī 14 的四性表述；Haribhadrasūri 系统化为七式。
locator: SEP §3.4.3：'An entity is somehow possessed of the character "being", somehow possessed of the character "non-being", somehow possessed of both, and somehow indescribable—all these four features characterizing it in accordance with the speaker's intention and not in an absolute fashion'（Āmī 14，逐字）；七式全句：'I can say that something exist; does not exist; exist and does not exists; is inexpressible; exist and is inexpressible; does not exist and is inexpressible; or exist, does not exist and is inexpressible'（逐字，含原文语法形态）；'Haribhadra is deeply influenced by the Investigation on Authority ( Āptamīmāṃsā [Āmī]) of Samantabhadra, which is amongst the first to teach that'
note: 七式句原文有 'exist and does not exists' 之语法形态，照录不改动。

claim: 关键辨析：七式不是七个真值，七者皆被认为真；syāt 译法不一（perhaps/from a perspective/somehow）。
locator: IEP §2：'These seven categories of predication are not to be understood as seven truth-values, since they are all seven thought to be true.'；'Each predication is preceded by a marker of uncertainty ( syat ), which I have rendered here as 'perhaps.' Some render it as 'from a perspective,' or 'somehow.''
note: 两处逐字核对；此为'七值判断'术语风险点的直接依据。

claim: vibhajya 回答实践：大雄时代沙门分析问题而非一边倒作答；Bhagavatīsūtra 的 loka 之问为实例；该经层累年代。
locator: SEP §3.4.1：'At the time of Mahāvīra around the fifth–sixth centuries BCE, a practice was observed in the numerous movements of wandering mendicants: instead of answering philosophical questions in a one-sided way, the teacher was analyzing ( vibhajya ) them, showing their different presuppositions and possible meanings.'；'Is the " loka " (here meaning both "world" and "self") eternal or is it, Jamāli, non-eternal?'；层累：'old parts 5 th –2 th centuries BCE, new 2 nd century BCE to 1 st century CE'（上标数字抓取展开为 5th/2nd，逐字核对）
note: 三处核对；本包未把 vibhajya 与佛陀'十四无记'作比（后者不在来源内）。

claim: 视角论（nayavāda）为元认识论装置；从 Siddhasena 与 Akalaṅka 的注疏世系展开。
locator: SEP §3.4.4：'the doctrine of perspective is a technical apparatus that deals with our ways to know something, like a meta-epistemology. It provides an exhaustive classification of the main epistemic perspectives through which one can consider the essentially complex knowable'（核至 'knowable'，逐字）；'From Siddhasena Mahāmati, Akalaṅka, and their respective lineage of commentaries, see especially Siddharṣigaṇi's Commentary to the Guide of Logic ( Nyāyâvatāravivṛtti [NAv], 900 CE) and Prabhācandra's Sun [that opens] the lotus of the knowable ( Prameyakāmalamārtaṇḍa [PKM], 980–1065 CE)'
note: 两处核对；IEP 通俗表述：'the doctrine of naya , or partial predication (sometimes called the doctrine of perspectives or viewpoints)'，'any judgment is true only from the viewpoint or perspective of the judge'。

claim: 推理分析的注疏链：Siddhasena（710–780）与 Akalaṅka（720–780）双起点，经 Siddharṣigaṇi、Prabhācandra、Vādi Devasūri 至 Yaśovijaya。
locator: SEP §3.3：'The more systematic analysis of inference in Jainism begins with the Śvetāmbara philosopher Siddhasena Mahāmati and his younger Digambara contemporary Akalaṅka Bhaṭṭa (720–780)'；'develops through a continued line of commentaries until authors like Vādi Devasūri (1143 CE) in his Commentary on the explanation of the nature of modes of knowledge and perspectives ( Pramāṇanayatattvālokālaṃkāra [PNT]) and later authors like Yaśovijaya (1638–1688 CE) and his Manual of Jain Logic ( Jainatarkabhāṣā [JTBh]) (Ganeri 2008).'
note: 两处逐字核对；Siddhasena 的 710–780 系年另见 SEP：'Siddhasena Mahāmati (710–780 CE), who indicates in his Guide of Logic ( Nyāyāvatāra [NA]) that indeterminate perception collapses with cognition'。

claim: 耆那教在感知—概念之争中的位置：概念论一方，与吠檀多同列，对峙佛教唯名论与正理—胜论实在论。
locator: SEP perception-india：'the nominalist by the Buddhist schools and the conceptualist by the Vedāntins and Jainas'；同段：强实在论 'is defended by the Nyāya-Vaiśeṣika and Mīmāṃsā schools'
note: 逐字核对；该条目明言不展开概念论论证，本包仅用其定位句（来源限度已记）。

claim: 两大文本传统并行：《谛义证得经》体系与 Kundakunda 内在论传统；后者接近数论而保持能动的自我。
locator: SEP §2.4：'a second tradition, next to that of the Treatise on What There Is . This tradition is that of Kundakunda.'；'"Kundakunda" is actually not a single author, but the name that stands for the collective authorship of a Jaina textual tradition composed in Prakrit (Jaina Śaurasenī) between the third and the eighth centuries CE around Karnataka in the South of India'；'The central teaching of Kundakunda in his Essence of the self ( Samayasāra [SSā]) is that karmic matter is never genuinely mixed with the self.'；'close to Sāṃkhya conceptions, while keeping the Jaina specificity of an essentially active self'；'Kundakunda's textual tradition is as influent as the TS, and is regularly revered as sacred texts in Jaina temples.'
note: 五处均逐字核对。
uncertainty: Kundakunda 教派归属未在 S1 文本标注（evidenceLimits 第6条）。

claim: 本体论核心命题：一切存在者同时恒住且变化——多面论的形上学根据。
locator: SEP §2.4：'every existing thing is at the same time persistent and changing (Bajželj 2013)'；§3.4.2：'one can give a proper account of a causal process only when one acknowledges both persistence and change.'
note: 两处逐字核对。
uncertainty: 本包不把它写成对佛教'一切皆无常'的直接论战文本（该论战形态不在来源内），只按 S1 的正面命题与其反对'唯非复合统一者为实在'的表述写。

claim: 七支谓词曾受商羯罗等人以不自洽为由的批评；自指难题：'始于可赞的可谬主义，终于站不住的相对主义'。
locator: IEP §2：'Historically, this view has been criticized (by Sankara, among others) on the obvious ground of inconsistency.'；'What begins as a laudable fallibilism ends as an untenable relativism.'
note: 两处逐字核对；站内商羯罗条目未载此批评（review.md 建议）。

claim: 业物质说使一切业（善恶）皆系轮回、解脱要求止息而非积累。
locator: IEP §3：'since they conceive karma to be a material substance that draws the soul back into the body, all karma, both good and bad, leads to rebirth in the body. No karma can help a person achieve liberation from rebirth.'
note: 逐字核对。

claim: 不拔高'科学性'：SEP 原文仅记经卷'被一些耆那教徒视为科学论著'，系社群自我理解的记录。
locator: SEP Conclusion：'come from this faith in the Scriptures, which are considered by some Jains as scientific treatises.'（逐字）
note: 这是本包拒绝'古代科学/生态哲学'式赞誉的来源依据：该说法属'一些耆那教徒'的自我理解。

claim: 大雄：此世传承源头；vibhajya 风气系于其时代；传统叙事的出家—证知—入灭。
locator: S1 开篇两句（见 overview 第1条 locator）；S6：'It may be more useful to think of him as a reformer and populariser of an ancient way of life rather than as the founder of a faith.'；'He is sometimes wrongly called "the founder of Jainism".'
note: 站内哲人名录（737人）无此人（python3 查'大雄/筏驮/Mahavira'均无）；站内《印度哲学》thinkers/4 用'大雄'写法，本包沿用。'创始人'措辞的两处否定证据见 locator。
uncertainty: 生年传统纪年 599 BCE，'some modern scholars prefer 540 BCE, or even later'（S6）。

claim: Umāsvāmin／Umāsvāti：谛义证得经归名者与注者；现存最古梵语耆那教论书；TS 1.1/1.4/5.38 定位。
locator: SEP §1.3：'The Treatise on What There Is ( Tattvārthasūtra , TS), associated with the name of Umāsvāmin and probably written by multiple authors around 150–400 CE, is traditionally considered as the first work and main representative of classical Jaina philosophy. It is the oldest extant Jaina treatise in Sanskrit.'；'TS 1.1. The path to liberation is constituted by right view ( darśana ), right knowledge, and right conduct.'；注者：'written in Sanskrit by Umāsvāti (400–450 CE)'
note: 三处逐字核对。
uncertainty: 经主与注主是否同一人不在来源讨论内（evidenceLimits 第4条）。

claim: Kundakunda：集体作者权之名；业物质从不真正与自我混杂；其传统与 TS 同样有影响。
locator: 同 overview 第19条 locator（'not a single author...' 与 'The central teaching of Kundakunda...' 两处逐字）
note: 站内哲人名录无此人。
uncertainty: 教派归属未标注（evidenceLimits 第6条）。

claim: Samantabhadra：《Āptamīmāṃsā》作者、四性表述的早期出处。
locator: SEP：'the Investigation on Authority ( Āptamīmāṃsā [Āmī]) of Samantabhadra, which is amongst the first to teach that'（逐字）；Āmī 14 全文见 overview 第12条 locator
note: 年代未在来源内注明。

claim: Siddhasena Mahāmati：Śvetāmbara；710–780；推理分析起点；无分别感知与认知融合之辨。
locator: SEP：'begins with the Śvetāmbara philosopher Siddhasena Mahāmati and his younger Digambara contemporary Akalaṅka Bhaṭṭa (720–780)'；'Siddhasena Mahāmati (710–780 CE), who indicates in his Guide of Logic ( Nyāyāvatāra [NA]) that indeterminate perception collapses with cognition'
note: 两处逐字核对。
uncertainty: 与通说'两 Siddhasena'之辨不在来源内（evidenceLimits 第13条）。

claim: Akalaṅka Bhaṭṭa：Digambara；720–780；《Rājavārttika》（御注）。
locator: SEP：'his younger Digambara contemporary Akalaṅka Bhaṭṭa (720–780), author of the Royal Commentary [to the Treatise on What there is] ( Rājavārttika [RV]) (Balcerowicz 2016b; Shah 1967)'
note: 逐字核对。

claim: Haribhadrasūri：七式系统化者；深受 Samantabhadra 影响；770 CE 系年出自宇宙志一节。
locator: SEP：'Jainas are known to go further and to introduce not two, but seven modes of predication. Haribhadra is deeply influenced by the Investigation on Authority ( Āptamīmāṃsā [Āmī]) of Samantabhadra'；'...in his Victory banner of the theory of non-one-sidedness ( Anekāntajayapatākā [AJP])'；系年：'the influential Compendium of Middle Earth ( Jambūdvīpasaṃgrahaṇī [JDS]) of Haribhadra Sūri (770 CE)'
note: 三处核对；AJP 的作者写法在 S1 中有 Haribhadrasūri/Haribhadra 两种形态。
uncertainty: 770 CE 系于《中洲辑要》而非 AJP（evidenceLimits 第12条）。

claim: 商羯罗：七支谓词的不自合批评者（站内人物，era 约7—8世纪）。
locator: IEP §2：'Historically, this view has been criticized (by Sankara, among others) on the obvious ground of inconsistency.'（逐字）
note: 站内 philosophers.json 有'商羯罗'（era 约7—8世纪，具体有争议），本包沿用站内纪年；站内条目未载此批评。
uncertainty: IEP 未指明所批的具体文本与论主，故 relation 落为学说层面批判。

claim: 甘地：'上世纪最著名的 ahiṃsā 奉行者'；以 brahmacarya 与 satyagraha 奠基；最大化扩展至一切有情感生命。
locator: SEP Pacifism：'Mohandas Gandhi is perhaps the most famous adherent of ahimsa of the last century.'；'Gandhi based his commitment to nonviolence on a spiritual foundation that emphasized self-renunciation ( brahmacharya ) and the positive action of the force of love or force of truth that he called satyagraha'；'Gandhi, for example, extended ahimsa maximally to include avoiding harm to sentient beings.'
note: 三处逐字核对；站内 philosophers.json 有'甘地'（school=印度哲学，era 1869-1948年），本包沿用；直接受耆那教影响的渠道不在来源内（evidenceLimits 第7条）。

claim: 大雄→谛义证得经：经文把圣典主题整合为连贯体系。
locator: SEP §1.3：'It aims to integrate themes tackled in canonical literature in a coherent philosophical system.'（逐字）
note: 文本体系化关系，非可考师授。

claim: 谛义证得经传统与 Kundakunda 传统并行：'第二传统'；两者同受尊奉。
locator: SEP §2.4：'a second tradition, next to that of the Treatise on What There Is . This tradition is that of Kundakunda.'；'Kundakunda's textual tradition is as influent as the TS, and is regularly revered as sacred texts in Jaina temples.'
note: 两处逐字核对；标为'编辑并置'以免写成直接接触。
uncertainty: 两传统直接接触细节不在来源内。

claim: Samantabhadra→Haribhadra：文本影响（'深受影响'）。
locator: SEP：'Haribhadra is deeply influenced by the Investigation on Authority ( Āptamīmāṃsā [Āmī]) of Samantabhadra, which is amongst the first to teach that'（逐字）
note: 来源明载的影响关系。

claim: Siddhasena↔Akalaṅka：Śvetāmbara/Digambara 各一的'同代人'并立。
locator: SEP：'begins with the Śvetāmbara philosopher Siddhasena Mahāmati and his younger Digambara contemporary Akalaṅka Bhaṭṭa (720–780)'（逐字）
note: 'younger... contemporary' 为来源明载；私人交往不在来源内。

claim: Akalaṅka→Umāsvāmin：御注关系与连续注疏链。
locator: SEP：'author of the Royal Commentary [to the Treatise on What there is] ( Rājavārttika [RV])'；'develops through a continued line of commentaries until authors like Vādi Devasūri (1143 CE)... Yaśovijaya (1638–1688 CE)'（逐字）

claim: 商羯罗→七支谓词（学说层面批判）。
locator: IEP：'Historically, this view has been criticized (by Sankara, among others) on the obvious ground of inconsistency.'（逐字）
note: 批判对象是七支说；落点 Umāsvāti 传统为学理定位，IEP 未载个人论战记录。

claim: ahiṃsā 传统→甘地：同一德性的传统与实践者；不写师承。
locator: S1：'A peculiarity of Jainism is to essentially associate these renunciatory liberating practices with the imperative of non-violence ( ahiṃsā )'；S2：'The cardinal rule of interaction with other jivas is the rule of ahimsa.'；S3：'Mohandas Gandhi is perhaps the most famous adherent of ahimsa of the last century.'；S3 三教共享：'Hindus, Jains, and Buddhists share a concern for ahimsa or nonviolence as a basic moral virtue.'
note: 四处逐字核对；'Pacifism can be connected to a larger project of spiritual transformation, as in Gandhi's commitment to ahimsa or nonviolence.' 亦核对。
uncertainty: 直接渠道细节不在来源内（evidenceLimits 第7条）。

claim: 大雄传教年代（传统纪年）与 vibhajya 风气。
locator: S1：'At the time of Mahāvīra around the fifth–sixth centuries BCE, a practice was observed in the numerous movements of wandering mendicants'（逐字）；S2：'a teacher of the sixth century BCE, a contemporary of the Buddha'（逐字）；S6：'Mahavira was originally born as Vardhamana in north east India in 599 BCE (that's the traditional date but some modern scholars prefer 540 BCE, or even later).'（逐字）
note: 三处核对；年份全按传统纪年标注。
uncertainty: 年代出入并存（evidenceLimits 第1条）。

claim: Pārśva 传统：大雄父母为其 follower；四原则加大雄所加贞洁。
locator: BBC：'He was a prince, the son of King Siddhartha and Queen Trishala, who were members of the kshatriya (warrior) caste and followers of the teachings of Parshva.'；'Mahavira added the principle of chastity to the four Jain principles already given by Parshva ( no violence , no lying , no stealing , no possessions ).'（逐字，词间空格为抓取形态）
note: 两处核对；年代未在来源内，节点不系年。
uncertainty: 传统叙事层；序数不在来源内。

claim: jīva 定义：自我为认知与无分别感知的经验；无碍的意识。

claim: 七支谓词七式与'非七个真值'辨；syāt 译法并列。
locator: SEP 七式全句：'I can say that something exist; does not exist; exist and does not exists; is inexpressible; exist and is inexpressible; does not exist and is inexpressible; or exist, does not exist and is inexpressible'（逐字，含原文语法形态）；IEP：'These seven categories of predication are not to be understood as seven truth-values, since they are all seven thought to be true.'（逐字）；syāt：'Each predication is preceded by a marker of uncertainty ( syat ), which I have rendered here as 'perhaps.''（逐字）　（其余定位同 packet 对应 overview/thinkers 各条 locator）
